description: STEM PhD applicant with strong research background in AI/ML

input.research_interests: Reinforcement Learning, Large Language Models, AI Alignment
input.relevant_experience: Published two papers at NeurIPS. Research assistant at Stanford for 2 years focusing on scalable RL algorithms.
input.academic_achievements: B.S. in Computer Science, GPA 4.0. Top of class.
input.career_goals: Become a leading AI researcher in academia, focusing on aligning powerful AI systems with human values.

evaluation_criteria: The SOP should strongly emphasize the applicant's research background (NeurIPS papers), clearly align with a PhD program's focus on academic research, and avoid overly generic statements about AI.

description: MBA applicant looking to switch from Engineering to Product Management

input.relevant_experience: Senior Mechanical Engineer at Tesla for 5 years. Led cross-functional teams to launch the Model Y HVAC system.
input.career_goals: Transition into Product Management in the tech industry to bridge the gap between engineering execution and business strategy.

evaluation_criteria: The SOP should highlight leadership and cross-functional experience at Tesla. It must convincingly explain the pivot from engineering to Product Management and how an MBA facilitates this.

description: Humanities Master's applicant focusing on cultural studies

input.research_interests: Urban sociology, diaspora studies, and intersectional identity.
input.relevant_experience: Volunteer coordinator at a local NGO for 3 years. Conducted independent ethnographic field studies on immigrant communities in New York.
input.career_goals: Work in public policy or international development, creating culturally responsive social programs.

evaluation_criteria: The tone should be empathetic and analytical. It should clearly connect the ethnographic field studies to the target program and career goals in public policy.

input.relevant_experience: Captain of the high school robotics team. Built a mobile app for tracking local environmental data.
input.academic_achievements: High School Valedictorian. Perfect SAT score.
input.career_goals: Become a software engineer to build tools that solve real-world environmental challenges.

evaluation_criteria: The SOP should reflect a passionate high school student's perspective. It should focus on the robotics and app development experience as indicators of potential.

description: Medical student applying for Internal Medicine residency

input.relevant_experience: Clinical rotations at Mass General Hospital. Co-authored a paper on novel antibiotic delivery mechanisms.
input.academic_achievements: M.D. from Harvard Medical School, Honors in Internal Medicine clerkship.
input.career_goals: Combine clinical practice with translational research in infectious diseases.

evaluation_criteria: The SOP must be highly professional and clinical in tone. It should balance clinical experience with the specific research interest in infectious diseases.
